about: Hand-written coach replies for the Jev gold set: cases the eval personas rarely produce, such as people sharing customer or suspect details, and tricky edges of the other checks. Everything here is fictional: the team is the sample fraud strategy and analytics team, every customer, suspect, shop and place name is invented, every email address is at example.com, and the digits of every phone, ID, account, card, device, agent and case number start with 00 (after any country code or letter prefix such as ACC-), even when only the last digits are given, so none can be real. Items whose id starts with tp- are meant to hold details of a specific customer or suspect somewhere in the conversation or the reply; items starting tpn- look similar but hold none (fraud types in general, colleagues, teams, totals), so that Jev's false alarms can be counted too. The gold set is split by id into a tuning part and a held-back checking part, and these ids were chosen so that at least 12 tp- items land in each part; test/jevSeed.test.ts checks this, so run the tests after adding, renaming or removing one. npm run jev:label labels these with the eval replies. The note on each item says what it is meant to test, for people reading the file; the labels come from Opus and from people, never from the note.
